A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Generative Densification study, including complete main text and Appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable matching throughout; differences are confined to front matter and one grammatical correction.

before.justification: v1 reports original object- and scene-reconstruction experiments, cross-dataset evaluations and masking ablations in Tables 1–5, including the DL3DV evaluation in Appendix A.

after.justification: v3 retains the original quantitative experiments in Tables 1–5 and qualitative results throughout the main text and Appendix E.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendices B–D retain identical Gaussian selection, serialized attention, upsampling, learnable masking, residual generation, backbone adaptations and training objectives.

E1.justification: Both versions use Gobjaverse, GSO and Co3D for object reconstruction, and RE10K, ACID, DTU and DL3DV-10K for scene reconstruction. Appendix A's DL3DV evaluation already appears in v1; no dataset or test scenario is added.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding Tables 1–3 and 5, including LaRa in object comparisons, MVSplat and DepthSplat on RE10K, and MVSplat-finetune on DL3DV.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices A and D preserve the splits, resolutions, training budgets, view sampling and PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS metrics. DL3DV retains five input views, 56 evaluation views and the same frame-span settings.

E4.justification: The Gaussian-attribute analysis in Figure 8, Gaussian-count and learnable-masking ablations in Table 4, cross-dataset tests and layerwise qualitative examples in Appendix E are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The same point-estimate reporting practice is retained.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–5 and qualitative result figures are unchanged. For example, Ours retains RE10K PSNR 27.08 in Table 2 and DL3DV PSNR 17.76 and 16.46 for the respective frame spans in Table 5.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(15), Gaussian-count definitions in Appendix C and loss definitions in Appendix D are identical. No assumptions, mathematical reasoning or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same proposed contribution and claims about fine-detail reconstruction, cross-dataset generalization and performance with comparable or smaller models.

C2.justification: The explanations involving small overlapping Gaussians and the masking quality–efficiency tradeoff remain identical. Appendix C also retains the same qualification about unstable training when predicting spherical-harmonic residuals for scenes.

D1.justification: Hardware and training durations in Section 4.1, implementation details in Appendices C–D, hyperparameters in Tables 6–7 and disclosed project links are unchanged.

R1.justification: Related-work coverage, research positioning and all 47 bibliography entries are unchanged. The grammatical correction in Section 2 does not alter any characterization of prior work.

P1.justification: v3 updates affiliations from Sungkyunkwan University alone to Yonsei and Sungkyunkwan Universities, updates the arXiv stamp, and corrects 'a set Gaussian representations' to 'a set of Gaussian representations' in Section 2. The narrative and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The title-page author block gains numbered affiliation markers and small spacing adjustments. Figures 1–11, Tables 1–7, their captions and the remaining page layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The affiliation updates and grammatical correction provide only incidental editorial refinement. Methods, experimental evidence, mathematical content, interpretations and reproducibility information remain identical, including the appendices, so overall paper quality does not meaningfully change.
